long_biography.plain_text:
Beretta's transformation from an Italian gunmaker into an international group took shape during Ugo Gussalli Beretta's long commercial career. He entered the family business in his early twenties and became commercial director, developing an approach centred on product quality, modern production and overseas markets. In the United States, he established local operations and built relationships with civilian, law-enforcement and military customers.

As company president, Gussalli Beretta also extended the name into clothing and sporting-lifestyle products while supporting a broader group structure. His sons now lead the holding company and original firearms manufacturer. Beretta Holding still lists him as a board member and Beretta USA president, while the company describes him as retired from operations and serving as a mentor and adviser.
